dslRule:
<!id: add-reconciler-isactive-check>
<!description: Add isActive() check to reconciler condition to fix lost aboutToReconcile() calls.>
<!severity: ERROR>
!$fThread.isDirty() && $fThread.isAlive()
=>
$fThread.isActive() || !$fThread.isDirty() && $fThread.isAlive()
;;
summary: Replace a boolean logical expression from `!$fThread.isDirty() && $fThread.isAlive()` to `$fThread.isActive() || !$fThread.isDirty() && $fThread.isAlive()`.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
